links.comparator_used: Base Llama 3.3 70B model without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Guideline consistency of responses rated by six expert psychiatrists (3-point scale), plus preference ratings
links.effect: RAG: 80 answers (63.5%) fully consistent vs 24 (19.0%) for baseline; major deviation 10 (7.9%) vs 48 (38.1%); OR = 9.1, 95% CI 5.3–16.3, p < 0.001; 110/126 (87.3%) rated as more or as correct as baseline; preference favored RAG in 78.7% of cases
links.tradeoff: Performance varied by vignette, with some errors in both retrieval and reasoning.
links.quote: The RAG system produced 80 answers (63.5%) rated fully consistent with the guidelines versus 24 (19.0%) for baseline, and only 10 answers with major deviation (7.9%) versus 48 (38.1%) for baseline.

design_hint: retrieval grounding on guidelines added to base LLM
